```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Monday at 08:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 8 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-dates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-pwsh@v3
        with:
          pwsh-version: '7.4'

      - name: Update MS Learn Dates
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Define the path to the script or inline logic to update dates
          # Assuming there is a script in the repo or we use inline logic
          # For this example, we assume a script exists or we perform a simple update
          # If no specific script exists, this step might need adjustment based on actual repo structure
          
          # Example: If there's a specific script to run
          if (Test-Path "scripts/Update-MSLearnDates.ps1") {
            & ./scripts/Update-MSLearnDates.ps1
          } else {
            Write-Host "No update script found. Skipping date update."
          }

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update MS Learn dates"
          title: "chore: update MS Learn dates"
          body: |
            Automated update of Microsoft Learn documentation dates.
          branch: "chore/update-mslearn-dates"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automation
            documentation
```
